notes.title: Enemy Improvements & Radar Additions
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! We’ve released a new update for Qume. We’ve taken player feedback into account and added new features to the game. Here are the changes:[/p][p]🔧 Gameplay & Mechanics[/p][p]⛽ [b]Fuel System Updated:[/b] Fuel now decreases more slowly when it’s low.[/p][p]👀 [b]Enemy Counter:[/b] The number of enemies in a camp is now tracked (will be used in future systems).[/p][p]🚐 [b]Vehicle Radar Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Camps are now displayed on the radar with their distance.[/p][/*][*][p]Distance text has been added to the radar (made easier thanks to player feedback).[/p][/*][/list][p]🎯 [b]Enemy Health:[/b] The health of the enemy you’re looking at now appears at the top of the screen.[/p][p]🛠️ Fixes & Adjustments[/p][p]🏚️ The church navmesh was floating, all navmesh issues have been fixed.[/p][p]🔫 The missing [b]headshot sound[/b] from the last update has been restored.[/p][p]🌪️ The storm system has been disabled until the new version is ready.[/p][p]👤 Enemies[/p][p]🪖 [b]New Enemy Types:[/b] Two new enemies using the Barett and M249 have been added.[/p][p]🔄 [b]Reload Animation:[/b] Enemies now reload.[/p][p]💣 [b]Grenade System:[/b] Enemies can now throw grenades, with markers showing where they land.[/p][p]🪑 [b]New Behavior:[/b] Enemies sometimes fire while crouching (previously only while standing).[/p][p]🔮 Coming Soon[/p][p]We’d like to share one of the new systems we’re working on:[/p][list][*][p]Enemies will now move in separate groups.[/p][/*][*][p]These groups will be able to fight each other.[/p][/*][*][p]Players may randomly encounter these battles while exploring the world.[/p][/*][/list][p]This feature will make the world more dynamic and full of surprises. Coming soon![/p][p]👉 Your feedback is very important to us. Try out the new systems and share your thoughts with us![/p]

notes.title: Desert Traders & Night Vision Goggles! 🌙🔧
notes.notes:
🏜️ Roaming Desert Traders
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596466/b7fb8112422862e73d9551e72aead2ce56daa280.png[/img]
Traders are now driving through the desert in rugged pickup trucks.
Find them out in the wild and check the back of the truck to trade gear for gear — no money involved!
Each encounter offers randomized loot, including:

🔩 Weapon attachments

🔧 Upgrade components

🧃 Usable items
Every visit is different. Every inventory is unpredictable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596466/d3c6aa70bf7d8498c8a148b5dfe54fc79ae73b70.png[/img]

🌘 Night Vision Goggles
Wandering blind in the dark is over.
The new night vision goggles attach to your helmet and light up the darkness.
Night raids? Now totally viable.
Tactical, immersive, and extremely useful in the pitch-black desert nights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596466/621042fa95c568d1473b2ce8b04ddec917886509.png[/img]

These features are fully integrated in the launch version coming tonight.
Get ready — Qume’s unforgiving world just got even more dynamic… and more dangerous.

notes.title: Vehicle Systems Preview
notes.notes:
The vehicle in Qume isn’t just a means of transportation — it’s a mobile base, control hub, and survival tool all in one. Every switch, screen, and gauge has a purpose. Here’s a look at the fully interactive cockpit setup, right from the driver’s seat:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596466/36415dc31334b2e6b48b3b8ba32521e698a79f82.png[/img]
🔧 Left Panel:
Fuel Pump Switch

Start/Stop Button
→ You’ll need to activate the fuel system manually before starting the engine. It’s not instant, but it’s immersive.

🧭 Center Panel:
8 Analog Gauges:

Speed

Boost

RPM

Fuel

Water Temperature

Oil Temperature

Oil Pressure

Voltage

LED Indicator Display:

Low Fuel

AWD Active

Lights On

And more…

→ Keep an eye on vehicle health and system status at all times.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596466/f7d5e44079203df8dd52a89bcc2908ce45529900.png[/img]
🖥️ Right Panel:
Terminal Display:

Logs all actions:
Engine started, Fuel pump activated, Lights turned on...

Vehicle Control Switches:

Lights

Top Lights

AWD

Wipers

Suspension Swiftness

→ Adjust your vehicle to fit the environment. Dust storm? Turn on the wipers. Rough terrain? Engage AWD.

📡 Far-Right Panel:
Caravan System Monitor:

Onboard system health

Structural “Integrity” status

Topographic Radar Screen:

Compass

Wind speed and direction

Dust level

→ Environmental data is crucial — plan your next move accordingly.

Everything in this cockpit is functional — not just visual flair. Every button, switch, and screen plays a role in your survival experience.
